title: Your fridge is a heat shuffler

segments.text: Your fridge is a heat-shuffling machine.
It pulls warmth from your food and then dumps that heat outside.
A tiny gas travels inside the coils, absorbing heat from your leftovers and releasing it elsewhere.
This happens because of a compressor that squeezes the gas, raising its pressure and temperature.
When it cools down later, it pulls heat again.
The fridge moves heat against a gradient, and the compressor keeps this cycle humming.
That’s why your pizza stays cold—the fridge moves heat out of the food.
